items.summary: Brown-Forman Corporation (NYSE:BF-B), the maker of Jack Daniel’s, warned that alcohol demand in developed markets is likely to remain weak through fiscal 2027. items.title: Ready-to-Drink Rising for Brown-Forman
items.summary: Americans are buying fewer bottles of liquor these days, but Brown-Forman says it is seeing momentum in cans. The Jack Daniel’s maker said ready-to-drink cocktails helped offset a slowdown in tequila and declining sales of used barrels in its most recent quarter.
